description: Swift source file defining the RemindersService class, which implements functionalities to list and add reminders using EventKit framework. It manages permissions, constructs reminders, and retrieves reminder lists.

classes.name: RemindersService
classes.description: Final class providing methods to list and add reminders through EventKit, implementing the RemindersServicing protocol.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a list of reminders based on provided parameters, including filtering by status and limiting result count.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new reminder with specified details, handling permission checks, date parsing, and list resolution.

methods.name: resolveList
methods.description: Private static method to resolve a reminder list (calendar) by ID or name, or fallback to default.
